purpose: Keep terminal contact action ownership atomic and prevent repeated exact scans in the same failed physical region

evaluation.training_gate: at least 18/20 success, at most two 300-step failures, at least one success after coordinate recovery, and no oracle or log grid used for actions or scoring
evaluation.smoke_result: final smoke v3: 2/3, Wilson 95% 20.8%-93.9%, mean 216.0, median 260, one 300-step failure; zero contact-owner mismatches
evaluation.training_gate_result: formal unseen gate v1: 15/20, Wilson 95% 53.1%-88.8%, mean 175.8, median 162, five 300-step failures, zero contact-owner mismatches, and zero successes after coordinate recovery
evaluation.post_fix_validation_result: same-seed regression v2 after repairing the v1 in-region route-stall deadlock: 16/20, Wilson 95% 58.4%-91.9%, mean 170.85, median 180, four 300-step failures; this is not a new holdout gate

failure_analysis.16702: Never entered contact; two coarse world routes exhausted obstacle recovery outside the contact region.
failure_analysis.16714: One coordinate recovery made verified progress, but no in-range attack was obtained; an exact scan failed and the second approach reached the episode cap.
failure_analysis.16716: Reached in-range contact and observed a disappearance, but did not collect the drop; a later route blocked outside the contact region.
failure_analysis.16719: Reached in-range contact and observed a disappearance, but 66 drop-recovery steps did not collect it before the episode cap.
failure_analysis.remaining_bottleneck: The four gate-v2 failures span coarse terrain routing, local reachable-contact acquisition, and two downstream pickup failures; the v9.5 ownership invariant itself had zero mismatches.

note: Independent v9.5 profile. v9.4 and older profiles remain frozen. This is an upstream ownership/locality repair; it does not add drop-path tuning or learned control.
